_about: Loot filter presets (polish1 item 68, director 2026-11-20 'add some presets for different usecases'): buttons at the top of Settings > Loot filter (game/loot_filter_menu.gd). Each sets the whole filter (core/loot_filter.gd: min = lowest tier shown, no_beam = tiers without a beam, chase / traits = highlight, makers = maker ids to highlight) and which tier chimes are off (chime_off; the same ticks as the Sounds page). Edit freely; tier ids: grey green blue purple gold orange rainbow pony.

presets.name: Everything
presets.desc: Every drop shows, every beam and chime on.

presets.name: Early game
presets.desc: Hide Commons; quiet chimes for Uncommon and Rare.

presets.name: Colosseum farming
presets.desc: Epic and up only; beams from Legendary; traits highlighted.

presets.name: Chase hunter
presets.desc: Mythic and up, plus every chase gun starred.

presets.name: Zombies rounds
presets.desc: Less clutter while training: Rare and up, beams only from Epic.

presets.name: Quiet
presets.desc: Everything shows but only Legendary and up chime.
